AdCP API ​

API endpoints for integrating AdRail with AdCP (Ad Context Protocol).

Connect to AdCP Agent ​

Link an AdRail escrow to an AdCP campaign/agent.

http
POST /v1/adcp/connect

Request Body ​

FieldTypeRequiredDescription
escrow_idstringYesAdRail escrow ID
adcp_agent_urlstringYesAdCP agent base URL
auto_record_impressionsbooleanNoAuto-record impressions from webhooks (default: true)
auto_settlebooleanNoAuto-settle payments (default: true)
media_buy_configobjectNoCreate media buy on connect
webhook_urlstringNoOverride webhook base URL

Media Buy Config ​

FieldTypeDescription
buyer_refstringYour reference for this campaign
packagesarrayPackage IDs to include
total_budgetnumberTotal budget in USD
currencystringCurrency code (default: USD)
start_datestringISO 8601 start date
end_datestringISO 8601 end date
targeting_overlayobjectAdditional targeting constraints
creative_deadlinestringDeadline for creative submission

Example Request ​

bash
curl -X POST https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/connect \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "escrow_id": "esc_abc123",
    "adcp_agent_url": "https://ads.example.com",
    "auto_record_impressions": true,
    "media_buy_config": {
      "buyer_ref": "q1_campaign_2025",
      "packages": [
        {"package_id": "premium_ctv", "budget": 5000},
        {"package_id": "display_standard"}
      ],
      "total_budget": 10000,
      "end_date": "2025-03-31T23:59:59Z"
    }
  }'

Response ​

json
{
  "id": "adcp_xyz789",
  "escrow_id": "esc_abc123",
  "agent_url": "https://ads.example.com",
  "agent_name": "Example Ad Network",
  "adcp_version": "2.6.0",
  "media_buy_id": "mb_12345",
  "status": "connected",
  "webhook_url": "https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/webhook/events/adcp_xyz789",
  "webhook_secret": "whsec_abc123...",
  "auto_record_impressions": true,
  "auto_settle": true,
  "created_at": "2025-02-15T10:00:00Z"
}

List AdCP Campaigns ​

Get all AdCP-connected campaigns for the authenticated advertiser.

http
GET /v1/adcp/campaigns

Query Parameters ​

ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
limitnumber50Max results to return
offsetnumber0Pagination offset

Example Request ​

bash
curl https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/campaigns?limit=10 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx"

Response ​

json
{
  "campaigns": [
    {
      "id": "adcp_xyz789",
      "escrow_id": "esc_abc123",
      "agent_url": "https://ads.example.com",
      "agent_name": "Example Ad Network",
      "media_buy_id": "mb_12345",
      "status": "connected",
      "escrow_balance_usdc": 7500,
      "impressions_recorded": 25000,
      "spend_usdc": 2500,
      "auto_record_impressions": true,
      "auto_settle": true,
      "created_at": "2025-02-15T10:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2025-02-15T15:30:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "limit": 10,
  "offset": 0
}

Receive Webhook Events ​

Endpoint for AdCP agents to send webhook events.

http
POST /v1/adcp/webhook/:taskType/:operationId

Path Parameters ​

ParameterDescription
taskTypeEvent type (impression, media_buy, etc.)
operationIdAdCP connection ID

Headers ​

HeaderDescription
x-adcp-signatureHMAC-SHA256 signature
x-adcp-timestampISO 8601 timestamp

Request Body (MCP Webhook Format) ​

json
{
  "task_id": "task_456",
  "status": "completed",
  "timestamp": "2025-02-15T15:30:00Z",
  "result": {
    "impressions": 1000,
    "cost": {
      "amount": 10,
      "currency": "USD"
    },
    "publisher_id": "pub_abc"
  }
}

Response ​

json
{
  "status": "processed",
  "event_id": "evt_abc123"
}

Get Event History ​

Get webhook event history for an AdCP connection.

http
GET /v1/adcp/events/:connectionId

Path Parameters ​

ParameterDescription
connectionIdAdCP connection ID

Query Parameters ​

ParameterTypeDefaultDescription
limitnumber50Max events to return

Example Request ​

bash
curl https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/events/adcp_xyz789?limit=20 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx"

Response ​

json
{
  "connection_id": "adcp_xyz789",
  "events": [
    {
      "id": "evt_abc123",
      "event_type": "impression",
      "task_id": "task_456",
      "status": "completed",
      "processed_at": "2025-02-15T15:30:00Z",
      "created_at": "2025-02-15T15:30:00Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "evt_def456",
      "event_type": "media_buy.completed",
      "task_id": "task_789",
      "status": "completed",
      "processed_at": "2025-02-15T10:00:00Z",
      "created_at": "2025-02-15T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "limit": 20
}

Disconnect from AdCP ​

Terminate an AdCP connection. Escrow remains active for manual use.

http
DELETE /v1/adcp/connect/:id

Path Parameters ​

ParameterDescription
idAdCP connection ID

Example Request ​

bash
curl -X DELETE https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/connect/adcp_xyz789 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx"

Response ​

json
{
  "status": "disconnected",
  "connection_id": "adcp_xyz789",
  "message": "AdCP connection terminated. Escrow remains active for manual impression recording."
}

Error Responses ​

Validation Error (400) ​

json
{
  "error": "Validation failed",
  "details": {
    "fieldErrors": {
      "adcp_agent_url": ["Invalid URL format"]
    }
  }
}

Not Found (404) ​

json
{
  "error": "Escrow not found"
}

AdCP Agent Error (400) ​

json
{
  "error": "AdCP agent error",
  "details": [
    {"code": "BUDGET_LIMIT", "message": "Campaign budget exceeds account limit"}
  ]
}

Webhook Signature Invalid (401) ​

json
{
  "error": "Invalid webhook signature"
}

Webhook Signature Verification ​

AdRail webhooks use HMAC-SHA256 for authentication.

Verifying Webhooks ​

javascript
const crypto = require('crypto');

function verifyWebhook(payload, signature, timestamp, secret) {
  const data = timestamp + payload;
  const expected = crypto
    .createHmac('sha256', secret)
    .update(data)
    .digest('hex');
  
  return signature === `sha256=${expected}`;
}

Example ​

javascript
const express = require('express');
const app = express();

app.post('/my-webhook', express.raw({type: '*/*'}), (req, res) => {
  const signature = req.headers['x-adcp-signature'];
  const timestamp = req.headers['x-adcp-timestamp'];
  const payload = req.body.toString();
  
  if (!verifyWebhook(payload, signature, timestamp, WEBHOOK_SECRET)) {
    return res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid signature' });
  }
  
  const event = JSON.parse(payload);
  // Process event...
  
  res.json({ status: 'ok' });
});

Connection Status Values ​

StatusDescription

connectedFully connected and receiving events
pending_approvalMedia buy requires human approval
disconnectedConnection terminated
errorConnection failed
